title: Data contracts and curated mart for queryable Console usage analytics
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Define canonical data contracts and build a curated, query-optimized analytics mart for Console usage telemetry to serve dashboards, SLA/cost attribution, and ad-hoc exploration. This ticket covers schema design, retention/compaction policies, materialized view strategy, upsert/backfill plan, and migration steps for dependent dashboards and downstream jobs.
acceptance_criteria: Published data contract doc (Confluence) with canonical field names, types, and sample records for invocation, route, workspace, and feature entities
Curated mart implemented as materialized tables with documented partitioning and clustering; daily and hourly rollups created
End-to-end ETL tested on staging with backfill of 90 days and verified row counts against raw event source
Dashboard queries (top 10) execute < 2s on curated tables and freshness SLA < 1 hour
Migration plan executed for 3 signal dashboards with no-broken-contract guarantee and feature-flagged rollout
tasks: Spike: run cardinality analysis of route_id, workspace_id, and user_id distributions
Draft data contract and mapping from raw callstream events to canonical columns
Prototype materialized tables and sample queries on staging cluster
Implement incremental upsert pipeline using compact hourly snapshots
Create backfill job with idempotent steps and monitoring
Coordinate with Console frontend owners to validate fields and query patterns
Add tests and CI validation for schema compatibility and contract checks
Document migration steps and runbook for rollback
progress_updates: 2026-02-20: Kickoff meeting with Analytics, Console PMs, and Runtime. Agreed on goals and top-10 dashboard queries to optimize.
2026-02-24: Completed spike; found route_id has high cardinality but most queries filter by workspace_id + route_state. Suggested composite partitioning (workspace_id, date) to reduce scan costs.
2026-02-26: Draft data contract added to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Queryable+Curated+Mart. Shared with DS and PM for review.
2026-02-28: PR created for materialized table DDL and ingestion DAG: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3421. Initial review requested from @emily and @jordan.

2026-03-01: Review feedback: prefer hourly compact snapshots over micro-batches to simplify dedup/upsert logic; adjust retention to 365 days for detailed events and 730 days for rollups. Addressing feedback in follow-up commits.
2026-03-01: Incident note: observed duplicate ingestion for a 12-hour window in staging originating from earlier CDC job; added dedup fingerprint (event_hash) to contract and ingestion logic.
decisions: Use composite partitioning on (workspace_id, date) and clustering on route_id for the primary curated tables to optimize common Console query patterns.
Adopt hourly snapshot materialization with idempotent compaction job running at +10m to avoid late-arriving event races.
Add a stable event_hash column derived from (invocation_id, timestamp, tenant_salt) to enable robust deduplication across CDC retries.
Retain raw events for 365 days and pre-aggregated rollups for 730 days; archive older raw data to cheaper storage for audit use cases.
Require automated schema compatibility checks in CI for any producer changes that touch canonical columns (fail pipeline on breaking changes).
Expose dataset-level cost and freshness metrics to Console Optimize pipelines for future autosuggestions.
